top_signals.title: Oil Rises as Uncertainty Clouds US-Iran Peace Talks
top_signals.summary: Oil prices rose on Tuesday as a diplomatic resolution to the U.S.-Iran conflict remained uncertain, while disruptions to oil flows through key shipping routes persisted.Front-month Brent futures LCOc1 rose $1.04, or 1.24%, to $84.81 a barrel…
